state.objective: Evaluate experiments for an agent-authored language, where successful behavior, dependable changes, visible guarantees and independent libraries matter first. Tokens consumed through a complete successful task are a secondary metric, encompassing supplied context and failed attempts. Neither human taste nor line count is an acceptance rule. With no outside users, backward compatibility has no value. Generated TypeScript should use equivalent JavaScript/Bun primitives and necessary immutability/contract adapters. Advice cannot enact a language or spelling choice.
state.provenance: The baseline is the audited 02a549d2 source plus earlier 4c2db1e executions, whose compiler and runtime files are unchanged. Targeted type/project/resolver suites and all 14 assertion runtime checks passed. This support is narrower than evaluating an alternative implementation or measuring agent performance. Retain current normative rules until expressly revised. Separate saved reviews address pattern intent and finite error polymorphism; these questions avoid duplicating them. General effects, free backend imports and shared mutable aliases remain unsupported expansions.
state.values: For DI-02, record immutability and nominal tags already exist, but exported declarations make positional construction and visible-field with edits available to importers. There is no independent constructor visibility, and public functions may not expose private record types. Document decoders build the nominal representation from schema fields rather than invoke its factory. These inspected mechanisms imply a forgeable email(str value); a dedicated cross-package execution remains missing. Explicit wire decoding followed by factories and repeated sensitive-boundary validation is the strongest existing idiom and may deliver a correct app, without making type inhabitation proof of validation. A new boundary is incomplete unless it covers equalities, hidden fields in matches, copy changes, codecs/schema and fixture creation. Use canonical email, positive quantity and tenant-ID cases, including rejection of cross-tenant invoice access despite a valid ID. Owner policies rely on trusted minting code; a single checked validator requires defined normalization, recursion, effects and finite failures.
state.packages: The package loader in DI-05a has project-qualified identity and identity-hashed output paths, yet its Graph.Packages short-name index rejects a collision anywhere in the graph. A uses alias is applied too late to disambiguate two independent model declarations. Preserve direct-only imports, canonical internal checks and protected catalogue naming. Trials must combine those unchanged dependencies in a single consumer, modify only root aliases, introduce a transitive namesake and move the checkout. Resolve library imports in the library's own dependency context, keeping separately loaded versions/instances separate. Deterministic locks, source mapping and native import emission depend on a consistent canonical identity. Author-qualified package declarations form a valid alternative contract only with rewritten bare-name inputs, not a pass for the original unchanged libraries.
state.errors: In DI-05b the integer attached to an error is a diagnostic identifier; nominal matching uses its package/declaration plus type arguments. Authors enter active numbers in source and can.errors.json, with registries captured by locks. Both active and retired values collide globally today, enforced in loader, checker and runtime plans. The audit found these internal uses; it did not establish external consumers' numeric needs or cross-version rename policy. Scope-based, build-generated and direct textual reports must each specify all registry/locking/emission/reporting consequences. Acceptance uses independently repeated active numbers and reuse of a foreign retired number, distinct triggered failures and generic instances, and old/new reports after graph growth. Sharing a reporting code never makes two specializations one nominal error. Numeric hashes require explicit collision handling to guarantee uniqueness. Canonical owner identity is required but the package-import trial remains independent.
state.fixtures: DI-06 has sound full-root queue identities but brittle row selection: when compares its selector against the current assertion's unqualified label. Allocation remains FIFO per root, lexical table and invocation/reservation path, never an argument lookup. In historical executed projects, changing caller customer to renamed alone passed checking while the helper switched from fixture output to real text::from_int(7), giving 7; its own unit assertion continued to pass. This demonstrates activation coupling rather than a concurrency collision. Reusable exact-target templates are inert and expand under the local selector, leaving that coupling intact. Stubbing the helper as a whole plus its own unit tests is a strong existing option but does not exercise its body inside the caller path; ordinary callable injection also deserves comparison. All alternatives must retain attached roots, checked targets/arguments, FIFO lexical queues, recursive/callable/concurrent invocation identity and separate supplied/raw/real evidence labels. Test label renames/collisions, repeated calls, recursion and participants, unused fixtures and disappeared explicit links; a requested unavailable fixture cannot quietly become a real call.
state.variants: DI-07's current relation rejects differing instances of one generic variant before admitting leaf-set subsets between other types. Earlier running cases showed direct tagged<int> -> tagged<str> refusal and successful bridge and unit-leaf detours; focused contemporary tests corroborate the policy. No runtime-safety failure follows from that static inconsistency. Variants flatten into nominal leaves without wrapper construction, and codecs encode those leaves. Ordinary generic record identity remains specialization-specific. Trials must exercise all three paths along with nested variants, added leaves, option<int>/option<str>, shared none, differentiated some<int>/some<str>, generic record leaves and encoding roundtrips. Leaf-set semantics offer no variant branding; current nominal records can supply a wrapper baseline where branding is needed. Nominal variants would alter conversion, matching, representation and codec recovery, requiring allocation evidence. There is no measured comparative agent behavior yet.
state.trial_policy: The decision is which limited experiment yields useful technical evidence per added scope. Keep present best-practice code as a benchmark and do not presume any candidate wins. Predefine models, effort, repeats and equivalent tool/context access, then include initial authoring, held-out edits and diagnostic recovery. Advancement requires the relevant semantics to pass plus reproducible baseline failure or meaningful measured gains after considering tooling/libraries. Choose defer_measure if selecting a next experiment remains underdetermined. Answers to these five independent questions cannot depend on one another.

validated_value_trial.instructions: Choose the most informative limited DI-02 trial for preventing unauthorized manufacture of validated values through all admitted routes while comparing current practice; no language decision follows from this answer.

criteria.owner_record: Evaluate a record-shaped owner boundary: only its declaring package creates or copy-updates, while chosen read-only fields and leaf identity can be public. Concealed fields cannot be matched; comparison is an owner operation unless a stable public equality is expressly granted. Structural codecs/schema cannot manufacture it: factory-decode a wire record and project for encoding. Supply fixtures through owner-validated constants/factories. Compile access restrictions around frozen JS records, measuring adapter burden and trusted creation code.
criteria.opaque_value: Compare full authored opacity: the package alone wraps and unwraps, and public operations control every observation, equality and replacement. Identity may remain a variant leaf test without exposing fields; destructuring and consumer with are illegal. Explicit owner codecs target separate wire data, with no derived schema. Fixtures need actual owner-produced handles and projection/equality checks. Default to immutable branded wrappers, erasing only with proof; test whether the reduced consumer surface offsets extra operations and allocations.
criteria.checked_construction: Evaluate universally checked record creation through a designated owner predicate/normalizer over an unconstructed payload. Initial calls, with, generic decode and fixture completions share its finite failure contract; it cannot recursively construct the same target to validate. Keep visible fields, leaf patterns and post-validation field equality. Structural schemas do not assert predicate validity; decoding reports both error categories. Native validator invocation precedes freezing, with explicit recursion/effect rules and measured fallibility overhead.
criteria.defer_measure: Collect the absent end-to-end invalid-email paths and agent data for wire decoding, factories and sensitive-operation validation before prototyping a new abstraction. Retain the honest distinction between application correctness and guaranteed valid inhabitants.

package_identity_trial.instructions: Which bounded package-resolution trial best investigates unmodified library composition and retained visibility rules in DI-05a? Do not credit author-renamed inputs as the unchanged-library acceptance case.

criteria.qualified_imports: Compare directly written import targets composed of dependency key and package, optionally renamed within a file. Use project-local lookup for own packages and reserved catalogue identity; libraries consult their own dependency bindings. Maintain lock and loaded-instance distinctions in native emission, measuring the added source qualification.
criteria.manifest_handles: Evaluate source handles declared in each project's import map and bound to dependency/package pairs; a file may alias a handle. Library maps are independent, reserved catalogue handles stay protected, and invalid mappings fail early. Emit native modules and lock canonical targets irrespective of handle renames. Measure central remap benefits against another-file lookup costs.
criteria.qualified_declarations: Prototype author-qualified declaration names with convenient local aliases, acknowledging that existing bare declarations must change. Keep loaded versions distinct and make identical qualified declarations an explicit resolution conflict. This is a separate-input experiment rather than unchanged dependency composition; assess author coordination versus lookup indirection.
criteria.defer_measure: Prepare and run the missing complete duplicate-package, local-alias and deterministic-lock/relocation baseline before picking an alternative. Record current global naming's composition failure and collect agent tasks without changing resolution yet.

error_identity_trial.instructions: Select a technical DI-05b experiment that tests independently composed error reports without assuming absent consumer evidence; weigh unresolved number-based integrations and rename stability explicitly.

criteria.scoped_numbers: Compare local numeric allocation with owner-qualified report keys, including scoped active history and retirement. Revise all registry/lock/loader/checker/runtime consumers consistently; specialization identity continues to use the declaration and concrete parameters. Native pair serialization/maps implement it. Authors still maintain numbers and readers cannot interpret an integer alone.
criteria.build_numbers: Evaluate generated compact diagnostic codes whose deterministic allocation covers the complete lock graph, with canonical declaration identity preserved. Ship and retain a reverse table and build key; no cross-build numeric stability is promised. Generic instances retain their parameters beside a shared declaration code, and retired keys can be tombstoned. Change authored registry/source contracts and consumers together, measuring reporting-map obligations.
criteria.text_keys: Compare direct qualified declaration-key reports, retaining concrete generic arguments and only optional mapped build-local integers for demonstrated consumers. Define retired-key and rename/reuse policy in owner records, then migrate source, registry and downstream readers coherently. Native textual metadata favors independent interpretation while costing report tokens and deliberate key maintenance.
criteria.defer_measure: Defer scheme selection until numeric dependencies, release renames and report interpretation across two graph versions are specified and collision cases run. Today's global allocation remains the documented failing benchmark; zero outside users does not itself justify removing diagnostic contracts.

fixture_ownership_trial.instructions: Which limited fixture-activation comparison most usefully addresses DI-06's rename failure while preserving precise arguments and isolated occurrence paths? Account for the actual body coverage offered by existing stubs, templates and injected dependencies.

criteria.lexical_only: Evaluate owner-local row activation and forbid ambient matching from foreign roots. Keep lexical templates, caller stubs and independent helper assertions; integration either executes real code or uses ordinary dependency injection. Enforce scope using existing assertion contexts rather than exported links. Report the lost combined helper-body simulation as a coverage limit.
criteria.exported_scenarios: Compare explicit invocation-site attachment to named helper scenarios controlling the helper's own rows. The identity combines declaration and scenario, with declared nested links and separate paths for recursion and participants. Diagnose unavailable, inaccessible, ambiguous, unused and type-incompatible attachments. Lower metadata into existing assertion queues; encapsulated internals trade against a new public scenario contract.
criteria.exported_seams: Evaluate caller fixture attachment to specific typed seams deliberately published by a helper. Resolve a checked call path and keep seam signature ownership in the callee while behavior belongs to the root. Per-invocation paths isolate repeated/recursive/concurrent FIFO occurrences. Removed requested seams, changed types and unused required bindings diagnose. Existing contexts carry the compiled plan; greater control costs internal-detail exposure and edits.
criteria.defer_measure: Hold new ownership machinery while measuring the strongest template/stub/separate-test and ordinary injection alternatives against the root rename scenario. Record exactly which helper body each runs and the existing fragile selector behavior before choosing a bounded prototype.

variant_policy_trial.instructions: Which limited DI-07 semantics trial best investigates refactor-sensitive direct versus indirect compatibility, accounting for generic records, common option leaves and wire identity without inventing a branding mandate?

criteria.extensional_leaves: Evaluate extensional subset admission for variants after fully specializing every nominal leaf. Drop direct-only phantom-instance rejection, accepting equal-set direct and bridge/leaf routes but retaining distinct some<int>/some<str> and generic records; none belongs to either option. Native leaf tests and existing codecs need no wrapper. Measure prediction/repair and identity regressions relative to present admission.
criteria.document_current: Keep existing path-sensitive admission as the experiment's semantics and strengthen explanations: different specializations of one declaration fail directly, yet other sources use leaf inclusion. Promise neither provenance nor an unbypassable brand, and preserve flattened codecs/tests. Evaluate whether agents reliably predict/refactor this immediate-type rule with better diagnostics.
criteria.nominal_wrappers: Evaluate genuine nominal variant containers per declaration and specialization. Leaf construction is explicitly injected; pattern narrowing unwraps under visibility rules, and cross-container paths use exhaustive maps plus reinjection. Block implicit specialization bridges, allowing only deliberate reinjection of an exported leaf. Freeze branded JS wrappers absent proven-safe erasure and specify codec restoration of wrapper identity. Benchmark representation and agent-adapter costs versus ordinary nominal records.
criteria.defer_measure: Collect comprehensive existing-rule executions and refactor measurements across direct/indirect paths, ordinary options, generic leaves and roundtrips. Make no brand claim and select no new policy prototype until that baseline establishes the broader contract cost.
